credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: JSON object mapping a credential name to its policy: {"allowed_hosts": [...], "scheme": "header", "header": "Authorization", "template": "Bearer {value}", "value": "<Fernet-encrypted token>"}. Readable/reviewable; the value is ciphertext, not the plaintext secret. Only used by the 'Run Starlark Script (HTTP)' action.

encryption_key.title: Encryption key
encryption_key.description: Fernet key that decrypts the credential values in the Credentials field. Write-only secret.

description: Run a Starlark (Python-like) script inside a playbook to transform data and route branches, replacing a graph of nodes with a single script.
